_readme: sparkcapital.com/companies (Webflow, fetched 2026-09-05 by curl with a browser UA): the page server-renders 124 collection cards across six tabs (All, AI, Enterprise, Fintech, Frontier, Software); the same 45 companies repeat per tab. Fields per card: <h3> name, company-specs description, acquisition-spec exit marker ('NYSE: TWTR in 2013', 'Acquired by Facebook in 2014'), logo, external website link. Parsed by scratch/probe (re-runnable from scratch/probe/companies.html). This is the live SELECTED list, not the firm's full history: the archived Webflow listing carried 135 (2021) and 164 (2023) distinct companies, and the 2015-2019 WordPress /companies/ archive up to ~130.
